items.title: Finite type descends along a faithfully flat ring map
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that finite type descends along a faithfully flat ring map (statement lines 31659-31666). The proof does not measure generating sets: it expands finitely many generators of the base change as finite sums, takes the subalgebra generated by the coefficients, and uses flatness to embed its base change and faithful flatness to conclude that it was everything (proof lines 31668-31678). Using faithful flatness to detect equality of subalgebras is the step that makes the descent work. H2.
